questions: each object with missing: description of missing source; why: importance; kind: "source" or "schema"? For G1 and G2: missing source reference to section, kind "source"? For G5: missing document UR P0 -> kind "source". Provide IDs.

Also need to ensure "questions" array with objects: missing, why, kind. Additional optional fields: reference, section, etc but not required.

Also need "gap_review" entries unchanged.

Also need "question_review" as given.

Make sure overall JSON valid.

Now produce corrected response.
